cards.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models
cards.body: OpenAI released two new models, Sol and Luna, built from the same foundation as Astra. Both promise lower costs and improved accuracy.

cards.title: Anthropic Releases Opus 5.5 with Lower Pricing
cards.body: Anthropic announced Opus 5.5, calling it 'the strongest-performing model we've tested to date.' The new model offers performance at reduced costs.

cards.title: AstroForge Deploys AI in Space Probe Command
cards.body: AstroForge's Autonomy-1 features a small transformer-based AI model controlling spacecraft operations. This marks a significant step toward autonomous space exploration.

cards.title: Five AI Safety Sessions at TechCrunch Disrupt
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 features five AI safety sessions across the AI and Real World AI stages. Leaders from Anthropic, Nvidia, AWS, and Waabi will participate.

cards.title: Hello Robot's Stretch 4 Live Demo at Disrupt
cards.body: Hello Robot CEO Aaron Edsinger will demo Stretch 4 on the Real World AI Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 for early pricing.

cards.title: Final Week for Disrupt 2026 Exhibit Tables
cards.body: TechCrunch reopened its exhibitor program for one final week. Book your exhibit table by September 30 to showcase at SF's Moscone West.

cards.title: OpenAI Math Advisory Group Formed
cards.body: OpenAI created a math advisory group as its AI resolved over 100 open mathematical problems. The group will not have authority to slow or redirect research.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Outpaces ChatGPT Mobile Launch
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse exceeded ChatGPT's early mobile adoption metrics in US and Canada. Appfigures data shows Muse achieved higher downloads and daily active users.

cards.title: Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse AI Agent
cards.body: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse from accessing Amazon.com. Amazon cited its own AI models and inference platform as reasons to restrict access.

cards.title: Tabby Uses AI for Real-Time Bookkeeping
cards.body: Tabby, built by a former accountant, automates bookkeeping with AI-powered interfaces. It processes paperwork while providing real-time profit and loss insights.

cards.title: Google Launches $899 Googlebook AI Laptop
cards.body: Google unveiled the Googlebook, an AI-native laptop priced at $899 featuring deep Gemini integration. Gemini ties into cursor, dictation, widgets, and desktop experience.

cards.title: Data Center Construction Sparks Regional Debate
cards.body: Pennsylvania experienced two years of contentious AI data center debates. Communities continue to grapple with infrastructure expansion questions.

cards.title: Nscale IPO Tests Wall Street AI Concentration Appetite
cards.body: British AI data center developer Nscale depends on Microsoft and Anthropic for most revenue. The IPO will signal investor appetite for concentrated tech bets.

cards.title: Apple Store Architect Skeptical of AI Retail
cards.body: Ron Johnson, who built Apple's retail empire, dismissed Silicon Valley's AI shopping optimism. He argues Apple's competitive advantage lies in its people.

cards.title: AI Hype May Be More Reality Than Feared
cards.body: Experts warn that recent AI breakthroughs are overstated amid summer hype cycles. Timnit Gebru and Emily M. Bender examine what's real versus exaggerated in AI claims.

cards.title: Anthropic Claims Claude Finds Software Vulnerabilities
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude model reportedly outperforms most security experts at finding software bugs. Recent disclosures from Anthropic and Meta follow OpenAI-Hugging Face security incidents.

cards.title: Could AI Really Kill Us All Answered
cards.body: MIT Technology Review hosted a live roundtable addressing existential AI risks. The event explored bioweapon threats and extinction scenarios with expert analysis.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Assistant Has Critical Flaw
cards.body: Meta's privileged AI assistant Muse faces a serious zero-day vulnerability. The security issue poses risks to the company's AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Google Confirms Gemini Models Hacked Three Firms
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI models were compromised in May 2026 attacks targeting three companies. The security breach highlights vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems.

cards.title: Trump Launches AI Force Rejecting Slowdown Calls
cards.body: The Trump administration rejected calls for AI development slowdowns and launched an "AI Force" initiative. The move prioritizes rapid AI advancement over safety measures.

cards.title: Google Analyst Infiltrates Supply-Chain Hacking Gang
cards.body: An undercover Google analyst successfully infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking operation. The investigation uncovered tactics used against AI infrastructure targets.
